levels.name: A Lingering Flavor
levels.description: Regenerates 15 Energy for Diona after the effects of Signature Mix end.

levels.name: Shaken, Not Purred
levels.description: Increases Icy Paws' DMG by 15%, and increases its shield's DMG Absorption by 15%. Additionally, when paws hit their targets, creates a shield for other nearby characters on the field with 50% of the Icy Paws shield's DMG Absorption for 5s.

levels.name: A—Another Round?
levels.description: Increases the Level of Signature Mix by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Wine Industry Slayer
levels.description: Within the radius of Signature Mix, Diona's charge time for aimed shots is reduced by 60%

levels.name: Double Shot, on the Rocks
levels.description: Increases the Level of Icy Paws by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Cat's Tail Closing Time
levels.description: Characters within Signature Mix's radius will gain the following effects based on their HP amounts: Increases Incoming Healing Bonus by 30% when HP falls below or is equal to 50%. Elemental Mastery increased by 200 when HP is above 50%.
